name: Enterprise Knowledge Hub
description: Synthesizes cross-source enterprise knowledge with strict citation conflict detection, jurisdiction-scoped SOP/policy answering with abstention gates, and corpus freshness/duplication auditing across Google Workspace, SharePoint, and Confluence.

skills.summary: Scores source authority and recency across multi-repo hits, flags conflicting numerical/date claims, and verifies 100% claim citation coverage.
Filters policy and SOP clauses by jurisdiction, entity, and effective date, enforcing abstention when active coverage is missing.
Audits Drive, SharePoint, and Confluence inventories for overdue review dates, departed owners, near-duplicate titles, and unindexed ticket gaps.
